research_papers.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
key_contributions: Discovers emergent reflection and self-verification via pure RL on base models without preliminary SFT.
Demonstrates multi-stage training pipeline matching OpenAI o1 on MATH-500 and AIME.
Distills reasoning traces into dense Qwen and Llama open models.
research_papers.abstract: We introduce our first-generation reasoning models, DeepSeek-R1-Zero and DeepSeek-R1. DeepSeek-R1-Zero, a model trained via large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) without supervised fine-tuning (SFT) as a preliminary step, demonstrates remarkable reasoning capabilities.

research_papers.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
key_contributions: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) compressing KV cache during inference.
DeepSeekMoE with 256 routed experts and auxiliary-loss-free load balancing.
DualPipe overlapping computation and communication across cross-node pipeline parallelism.
research_papers.abstract: We present DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token. DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention and DeepSeekMoE architecture for efficient training and inference.

research_papers.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
key_contributions: Comprehensive scaling recipe for dense models up to 405B parameters on 15.6T tokens.
Multi-stage post-training with iterative DPO and rejection sampling.
128k context extension via RoPE frequency scaling.
research_papers.abstract: Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly powered by foundation models. This paper presents Llama 3, a herd of language models natively supporting multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.

research_papers.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
key_contributions: Establishes realistic execution-grounded software engineering benchmark from real GitHub issues.
Requires autonomous agents to locate bugs across repos, edit files, and pass unit tests.
research_papers.abstract: We introduce SWE-bench, an evaluation framework consisting of 2,294 software engineering problems drawn from real GitHub issues and corresponding pull requests across 12 popular Python repositories.

research_papers.title: MMLU-Pro: A More Robust and Challenging Multi-Task Language Understanding Benchmark
key_contributions: Increases question choices from 4 to 10, eliminating random-guessing noise.
Reduces benchmark saturation by emphasizing multi-step reasoning.
research_papers.abstract: We present MMLU-Pro, expanding multiple-choice options from 4 to 10 choices, reducing trivial memorization advantage, and curating reasoning-heavy questions in STEM and business domains.

research_papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
key_contributions: Formulates interleaved Thought-Action-Observation loop that underpins modern agentic systems.
Reduces hallucination by grounding reasoning in external tool observations.
research_papers.abstract: We propose ReAct, where LLMs generate verbal reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. ReAct overcomes issues of hallucination in CoT and error propagation in action-only loops.

research_papers.title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-Precision
key_contributions: Warp-group asynchronous pipelining exploiting NVIDIA Hopper hardware features.
FP8 low-precision attention with numerical stability guarantees.
research_papers.abstract: We propose FlashAttention-3, designed specifically for Hopper GPU architectures (H100/H800), achieving up to 1.5-2x speedup over FlashAttention-2, reaching up to 850 TFLOPs/s.

research_papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
key_contributions: Replaces multi-stage RLHF with simple binary cross-entropy loss over preferences.
Eliminates need for separate reward model and online policy sampling.
research_papers.abstract: We show how to implicitly optimize the same objective as RLHF via a simple binary cross-entropy loss over preferences, yielding Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

research_papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
key_contributions: Introduced the multi-head Transformer self-attention architecture.
Replaced recurrent sequence models, establishing the foundation of contemporary LLMs.
research_papers.abstract: We propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and entirely relying on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.

recent_developments.title: DeepSeek Unveils DeepSeek-R1 Open Reasoning Model & Weights
recent_developments.summary: DeepSeek releases 671B MoE weights and 6 distilled dense models under MIT license, matching frontier commercial reasoning models.

recent_developments.title: DeepSeek V3 Released: 671B MoE Architecture with DualPipe

recent_developments.summary: Google announces Gemini 2.0 Flash offering real-time native bidirectional audio, 1M context window, and sub-second tool execution.
